title: AxiomSL Implementation Consultant – Cloud, Java/Python & Agile SDLC
description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking an AxiomSL Implementation Consultant with experience in software development, technology implementation, Agile delivery, and cross-functional collaboration. The role involves understanding technology and business requirements, designing appropriate solutions, preparing technical specifications, supporting implementation activities, and contributing to software quality and maintainability.
  
  
The consultant will work across technology teams to support implementation initiatives involving mobile, cloud, IoT, blockchain, and related platforms where applicable. The role contributes to business objectives by delivering well-documented, maintainable, and thoroughly tested technology solutions that respond to changing business needs.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* Strong understanding of technology platforms such as mobile, cloud, IoT, and blockchain.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Java, Python, or Node.js.
* Knowledge of the software development life cycle and Agile methodologies.
* Experience with software development tools and practices, including Git, JIRA, Confluence, source control, documentation, and work tracking.
* Experience preparing technical specifications, solution documentation, implementation notes, and feature-level requirements.
* Experience participating in code reviews, software testing, defect resolution, and technical support activities.
* Experience working with the software, programming language, documentation, source-control, and project-management tool versions used by the assigned Synechron project.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* Experience implementing or integrating technology solutions across mobile, cloud, IoT, or blockchain environments.
* Familiarity with automated testing, build, deployment, monitoring, and release-management tools.
* Experience with API integration, distributed systems, data exchange, or platform interoperability.
* Familiarity with technology architecture, design patterns, and solution documentation practices.
* Experience working with AxiomSL implementation activities or comparable financial technology, regulatory technology, or data-reporting platforms.

Equivalent tools and technologies may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities.
  
  
****Overall Responsibilities****

* Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand technology requirements and design solutions that meet business needs.
* Support the implementation, enhancement, maintenance, and integration of technology solutions.
* Develop technical specifications and detailed documentation for new features and enhancements.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical designs, implementation tasks, acceptance considerations, and delivery documentation.
* Stay current with the latest technology trends and advancements and suggest ways to incorporate relevant capabilities into existing solutions.
* Conduct code reviews to support code quality, maintainability, consistency, and adherence to applicable development standards.
* Participate in the resolution of technical issues and provide technical support to team members.
* Collaborate with the testing team to ensure that software solutions are thoroughly tested and meet agreed quality standards.
* Participate in SDLC activities, including planning, analysis, development, testing, deployment, support, and documentation.
* Contribute to Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, project planning, estimation, and delivery reviews.
* Identify risks, dependencies, gaps, and improvement opportunities and communicate them through appropriate channels.
* Support sustainable technology practices by encouraging reusable components, maintainable solutions, efficient processing, and long-term supportability.
* Deliver assigned implementation activities in accordance with agreed requirements, quality standards, timelines, and technical controls.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Java, Python, or Node.js.
* Ability to understand, develop, review, test, and maintain software components.
* Understanding of programming practices that support maintainability, scalability, readability, and testability.
* Ability to interpret technical requirements and contribute to implementation design.

****Preferred****

* Experience with more than one programming language.
* Familiarity with scripting for automation, testing, deployment, or technical support.
* Experience with programming languages relevant to mobile, cloud, IoT, blockchain, or platform integration solutions.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Understanding of how applications and technology platforms store, access, exchange, and validate data.
* Ability to define or review data-related requirements as part of technical specifications.
* Awareness of data integrity, data validation, access, and documentation considerations.

****Preferred****

* Experience working with relational or non-relational databases.
* Familiarity with data integration, APIs, data reporting, metadata, or structured data exchange.
* Experience supporting technology solutions involving regulatory, operational, or business data.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Strong understanding of cloud technologies and their role in software implementation and delivery.
* Awareness of cloud-related considerations such as scalability, availability, deployment, integration, security, and support.
* Ability to collaborate with cloud and infrastructure teams when developing or implementing cloud-based solutions.

****Preferred****

* Hands-on experience implementing or supporting cloud-based applications or services.
* Familiarity with cloud-native architecture, APIs, distributed systems, monitoring, and environment management.
* Understanding of efficient cloud resource usage and sustainable technology practices.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Ability to work with frameworks, libraries, platforms, and technology components relevant to assigned implementation work.
* Understanding of software integration, reusable components, dependencies, and compatibility considerations.
* Ability to evaluate the impact of framework or platform changes on solution design and maintainability.

****Preferred****

* Experience with frameworks and libraries used for Java, Python, Node.js, mobile, cloud, IoT, or blockchain solutions.
* Familiarity with API frameworks, integration libraries, testing libraries, or deployment components.
* Exposure to platform-specific implementation frameworks relevant to AxiomSL or comparable solutions.

**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****

* Knowledge of the software development life cycle.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies, including iterative planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and backlog or task management.
* Experience with Git or an equivalent source-control system.
* Experience using JIRA, Confluence, or comparable tools for work tracking and technical documentation.
* Experience participating in code reviews, testing, defect resolution, deployment, and technical support.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout implementation and delivery activities.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with automated testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery, build, release, and deployment tools.
* Experience with technical estimation, implementation planning, release management, and solution governance.
* Exposure to architecture documentation, design reviews, process improvement, or technology evaluation practices.

**Security Protocols**
****Essential****

* Awareness of secure software development and technology implementation practices.
* Understanding of access control, authentication, authorization, secure data handling, and protection of sensitive information.
* Ability to consider security, privacy, and operational risks when developing technical specifications and solutions.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with secure API integration, encryption, secrets management, security testing, and auditability.
* Experience supporting technology solutions subject to formal security, privacy, compliance, or governance requirements.
* Awareness of security considerations for cloud, mobile, IoT, blockchain, and distributed technology platforms.

****Experience Requirements****

* 5+ years of experience in software development, technology implementation, technical consulting, solution engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with one or more of mobile, cloud, IoT, blockchain, or related technology platforms.
* Experience with software development methodologies and tools such as Agile, Scrum, Git, JIRA, and Confluence.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and participating in code reviews.
* Experience preparing technical specifications, supporting testing, resolving technical issues, and maintaining implementation documentation.
* Experience with AxiomSL implementation or comparable platform implementation is preferred.
* Industry experience in technology, software development, financial technology, data platforms, or enterprise solutions is preferred.
* Candidates may also qualify through equivalent combinations of software development, technology consulting, platform implementation, systems integration, technical analysis, or solution delivery experience that demonstrate the required skills and outcomes.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Participate in daily stand-up meetings and project planning sessions to review progress, priorities, dependencies, risks, and implementation activities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, design solutions, prepare technical specifications, and support feature delivery.
* Write, test, review, document, and support the deployment of software solutions while working with testing teams to address defects and quality requirements.
* Provide technical support, contribute to implementation decisions within the agreed scope, evaluate relevant technology developments, and escalate material risks or dependencies when required.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* A minimum of 5+ years of experience in software development, technology implementation, or a related field is required.
* Certification in software development, cloud technologies, Agile delivery, technology architecture, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
* Relevant training in SDLC, Agile methodologies, programming, cloud platforms, technical documentation, testing, security, or platform implementation is preferred.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through technical learning, knowledge sharing, certification, and awareness of evolving technology platforms and implementation practices.

**Professional Competencies**

* Apply structured problem-solving and analytical reasoning to evaluate requirements, investigate technical issues, and develop practical implementation solutions.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, contribute to code reviews, support shared delivery objectives, and provide technical guidance where appropriate.
* Communicate technical specifications, solution options, progress, risks, dependencies, and issues clearly in written and verbal formats.
* Adapt to new technologies, changing requirements, different delivery environments, and evolving implementation priorities.
* Evaluate relevant technology trends and identify opportunities to improve solution quality, maintainability, integration, efficiency, and long-term sustainability.
* Take initiative, prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, maintain attention to detail, and deliver assigned work within agreed timelines and quality expectations.

* Utilize agentic development frameworks and automated testing tools to accelerate test creation, validation, quality assurance, deployment, and ongoing application maintenance.

* Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery velocity through the adoption of agentic development practices and intelligent automation.
* Assists clients with implementing new products, new releases and software upgrades. Responds to inquiries and requests from clients.
* Participates in analysis of client identified issues or problems which may require changes to software, procedures, or documentation.
* Diagnoses, troubleshoots and resolves common technical problems. Escalates as per procedures.

Skill Descriptors
  
  
Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching.
* Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience.
* Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position.
* Communicates well downward, upward, and outward.
* Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement.
* Maintains focus on the topic at hand.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Customer Support Policies, Standards and Procedures: Knowledge of the organization's customer support policies, standards and procedures; ability to guide customers on all company interactions.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Collaborates with other functions on establishing and documenting joint standards.
* Develops quality assurance and monitoring mechanisms.
* Advises on the development of customer support policies and practices.
* Implements cross-functional standards and procedures.
* Evaluates the impact of standards and policies across functional specialties.
* Analyzes existing and evolving procedures for their efficiency and effectiveness.

Software Product Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of technical aspects of a software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Supports and participates in major installations and customizations.
* Has knowledge of all technical and infrastructure components of the software product.
* Maintains and disseminates information on customer platforms and experiences.
* Collects, documents and maintains product configuration requirements and instances.
* Provides recommendations and documentation to field support on technical and platform issues.
* Elaborates on alternative product configurations, platforms, and implementation options.

Software Release Management: Knowledge of strategies, practices and tools for managing versions and distribution of software products and enhancements; ability to evaluate and improve release management practices and tools.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Participates in the development and testing of back-out procedures and recovery strategies.
* Oversees all aspects of release management for the entire installed customer base.
* Develops and disseminates communications about new release training.
* Drafts communications about product release delays.
* Develops distribution dates based on development, testing (QA), validation, packaging activities.
* Conducts impact analysis for major releases or critical applications; assesses benefits and risks.

Software Reliability Management: Knowledge of software reliability management; ability to develop and use principles, methodologies and metrics that increase software product performance and reliability.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Explains the process and considerations for defining product reliability requirements.
* Describes tools for gathering reliability information on installed products.
* Identifies reliability activities and tasks for the product development and maintenance plans.
* Monitors and analyzes system failures and corrective actions.
* Works with reliability testing methods and tools.

Performance Measurement and Tuning: Knowledge of system performance, testing and programming; ability to monitor, measure, and optimize system performance and network communication.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Monitors the performance of specific system components.
* Researches performance objectives and requirements for a component or application.
* Works with installed software tools for performance monitoring and reporting.
* Validates performance characteristics for specific technologies.
* Works with the performance measurements of hardware, software or network components.Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.

**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Emphasizes the business impact of failure and the criticality and timing of needed resolution so that problems can be avoided in the future.
* Creates trouble reports for all issues found and reviews solutions for completeness and correctness.
* Directs the resolution of communications problems in multi-vendor environments.
* Resolves a variety of hardware, software, and communications malfunctions.
* Coaches others on advanced diagnostic techniques and tools for unusual or performance-related problems.
* Facilitates the distribution of releases reports and correction packages to departments or clients.

description:

As an Engineering Manager, you will play a key role in researching and developing innovative products. You will also be responsible for creating project budgets and overseeing their successful execution throughout the year. * Collaborate with organizational leadership to develop an annual budget for the engineering department. Assess the tools and technologies required for efficient project development. Regularly assess the effectiveness of budget allocations. Work with leadership to allocate budgets for tools, training, and staffing needed to support
* Set clear expectations, goals, and objectives for each team. Ensure a balanced distribution of work among teams to optimize productivity. Encourage collaboration between teams to promote knowledge sharing and cross-functional problem-solving. Implement performance metrics to monitor the progress of each team.

* Delegate technical decisions to your senior engineers but ask the right questions to ensure that the product is scalable, secure, and reliable.
* Bridge the gap between product management and Engineering team by facilitating necessary interaction
* Anticipate and identify potential risks associated with the technical strategy, including technological challenges, resource constraints, and market changes. Develop mitigation plans to address identified risks, ensuring that the technical strategy remains resilient and adaptable.

* Demonstrate a forward-looking mindset by establishing and driving engineering and technology roadmaps aligned to business objectives. Leverage industry experience, emerging trends, AI capabilities, and engineering best practices to continuously improve software engineering, operational excellence, platform capabilities, and organizational maturity. Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and modern engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve productivity, quality, scalability, and speed to market.

**Required Experience**
Minimum 6+ years of hard-core coding experience is mandatory
  
  
Excellent hands-on experience in coding in Python/Java, ‘AWS/Microservices will be added advantage’
  
  
Good to have front-end framework knowledge like REACT/Angular.
  
  
Over all 9-13 Experience is mandatory.
  
  
Mandatory 2+ years of people management experience required .

description:
**Job Description**
**Our Mission:**
 We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.
   

  

**About Us**
 Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.


**Test Strategy \& Coverage**
* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.


**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**
* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.


**Functional \& Workflow Testing**
* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.


**XML and Publishing Validation**
* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.


**Data Layer Testing**
* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.


**API and Integration Testing**
* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.


**Performance and Reliability Testing**
* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.


**Collaboration \& Execution**
* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.

**Mandatory Requirements \& Qualifications** 
 :
   

  

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands\-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven, and webhook\-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.

* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai / Bangalore \- India
   

  

 Work Model \- Hybrid
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to Help customer transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role, and it is not a features team. It is a Multi deployment unit embedded, operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.
   

  

 This team operates as a POD inside Kinaxis — a small, tight unit with end\-to\-end ownership and a startup mentality inside a larger company. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self\-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.
   

  

 You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers — from warehouse floor to executive sponsor — designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed.
   

  

 💡 Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught — but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Build the data backbone for AI Agents on Maestro**
* Design, build, and operate production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — that feed agentic AI workflows on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform.
* Integrate customer data sources (ERP systems, data warehouses, supply chain applications, flat files, APIs) into a unified data layer that agents can reason over reliably.
* Build and maintain data platform services, tooling, and infrastructure that enable reliable data ingestion, processing, sharing, and discovery across customer deployments.
* Own data quality end\-to\-end: profiling, validation, anomaly detection, and lineage — because an agent is only as good as the data behind it.


**Ship AI Agents alongside the POD**
* Partner with AI\-focused FDEs to design, develop, and ship agentic AI workflows — including multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and tool\-use patterns — ensuring the data layer is production\-ready.
* Translate messy, real\-world customer data landscapes into clean, well\-modeled foundations that agents can consume — iterating rapidly from prototype to deployment.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack data pipelines, model context, API layers, and infrastructure — in live customer environments.


**Own the full solution lifecycle**
* Carry multiple customer engagements in parallel; set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when priorities shift, and own outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Define and track success in business terms: data freshness SLAs, pipeline reliability, query performance, exception rates — not just deployment completion.
* Drive platform engineering best practices through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD automation, observability, and automated testing across customer deployments.


**Work inside a POD team**
* Operate as part of a small, self\-directed POD within Kinaxis tasks traded fluidly to whoever has the right skills, focus maintained with urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings and repeatable data patterns into durable platform capabilities, not one\-off scripts.
* Serve as the technical face of the team in customer rooms — from IC\-level engineers to skeptical architects to VP sponsors and build genuine trust across all of them.


**Drive adoption and change**
* Guide customer data teams through solution transitions: the new data architecture has to stick, not just ship.
* Mentor customer teams on modern data engineering practices, agentic data workflows, and new operating patterns so capability transfers and does not remain dependent on you.


****What we are looking for****
**Bias to action**
 You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours — no waiting for perfect clarity.
   

  

**Self\-directed**
 You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver — without being told.
   

  

**Always learning**
 Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
   

  

**Customer\-obsessed**
 You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst — and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
   

  

**Comfortable with ambiguity**
 Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric — and you still ship.
   

  

**Drives change, not just code**
 You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
   

  

 The following are the technical areas we look for. You do not need depth in all of them — we look for strong foundations, a growth trajectory, and the ability to pick up what is missing quickly.
   

  

**Data Engineering \& Platforms (Primary)**
* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning at scale.
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of data modeling, schema design, and large\-scale data processing patterns.
* Experience with data governance practices: RBAC, PII handling, data lineage, data quality frameworks, and enterprise\-scale data management.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar).
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments — you have untangled broken pipelines at 2 AM and lived to tell the tale.


**AI \& Agentic Development**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications — RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
* Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns — when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.


**Software Engineering**
* Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
* Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.


**Data Engineering \& Platforms**
* Ability to build and maintain data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals.
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments.


**Supply Chain Domain (Nice to Have)**
* Prior exposure to supply chain planning, logistics, or operations domains is a genuine plus — not a requirement.
* Experience with or curiosity about platforms like Kinaxis, SAP IBP, o9, or Blue Yonder is welcome context.


**Experience \& Background**

* Prior exposure to customer\-facing technical roles — solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats — is a strong signal, though not a requirement.


**How You Will Succeed In This Role**

* You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities.
* You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end\-to\-end without requiring close supervision.
* You are curious and pragmatic — you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Keep four squads honest about what they can actually ship** 




 You will run the full Scrum ceremony set, including standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement and retros, for two to three product squads inside a single business unit, adjusting the ceremony rhythm per squad rather than forcing one template on all of them.
 



 You will track velocity, burndown and cross\-squad dependencies, and flag the ones that are actually going to blow a release date versus the ones that will resolve themselves.
 



 You will coach product managers and engineering leads on writing stories that can actually be estimated, and push back when a story arrives with the acceptance criteria still in someone's head.
 



 You will represent delivery status upward, translating sprint\-level noise into a release picture that a VP of Engineering can act on without five follow\-up questions.
 



 This role expects four to eight years of Scrum Master or agile delivery experience, including time spent supporting more than one team at once. You should be comfortable with Jira at an administrator level, know the difference between a blocked story and a slow one, and have said no to a scope change mid\-sprint at least once. A Scrum or SAFe certification helps but is not the bar, the bar is having run this before and having the scars to show for it.
 



**The team you would be supporting** 




 This is a US\-headquartered product company scaling its India engineering hub, hiring this role through Flexiple. The India engineering org is a little over sixty people today, organised into four squads that this role will rotate support across.
 



 Bengaluru, Pune or Remote (India), with a strong preference for candidates able to overlap a few hours with the US product team.
 



 Expect a recruiter conversation, a scenario\-based round on running a multi\-squad sprint cadence, a session with two of the engineering leads you would support, and a closing conversation with the hiring manager.
 



 This application is also kept on file for other delivery and agile\-coaching roles Flexiple is hiring for alongside this one.
